# Kudos Roofing

Family run roofing contractor based at 41 Avenue Road, Farnborough, Hampshire GU14 7BJ. Trading for over 25 years. Domestic and commercial.

- Mobile: 07973 193248
- Office: 01252 540396
- Email: info@kudosroofing.co.uk
- Google rating: 4.9 from 38 reviews
- Guarantee: minimum 10 years on all work, 20 years on high specification flat roofs
- Quotes: free, no obligation

## Services
- Re-roofs, slating and tiling
- Flat roof repairs and renewals
- Lead work and chimney repairs
- Loft conversions, dormers and Velux windows
- Fascias, soffits and guttering
- Scaffolding

Flat roof systems: single ply, high performance felt, GRP, Firestone rubber.

## Areas served
Farnborough, Aldershot, Fleet, Hartley Wintney, Frimley, Camberley, Chobham, Pirbright, Farnham, Yateley, Hook, Woking, Guildford, Basingstoke, Reading, Slough, and wider Hampshire, Surrey and Berkshire.
